name: Alon Leviev
biography: Alon Leviev (@_0xDeku) is self-taught security researcher with a diverse background. Alon started his professional career as a blue team operator, where he focused on the defensive side of cyber security. As his passion grew towards research, Alon joined SafeBreach as a security researcher. His main focus include operating system internals, reverse engineering, and vulnerability research. Alon spoke at various security conferences such as Black Hat EU 2023, CanSecWest 2024 and CONFidence 2024. Before joining the cyber security field, Alon was a professional Brazilian jiu-jitsu athlete, where he won several world and european titles.
